_comment: Instruction/call ceilings for the JSON typed readers, the snapshot copy and the interop read bodies in the json_svm_profile image (x86-64, -O2, -march=compatibility). Pinned on 2026-11-08 from the WS7 image (a1d8782) with ~10% headroom; a change that lowers a value re-pins it downward (never upward without a ledger ruling). Before WS7: HeapTape_copy 815/32 (its extent scan and rebase called the checked `word` hook per word; the WS7 body inlines both passes over the heap copy and reads the source once through SvmTape_copyWords). Shape only; timings come from json_typed_pair.
